You review a body-worn camera recording against a written account of the same incident.
For each numbered CLAIM, find where the recording shows or says it.
TIME: our software stamped every frame in the top-left corner with "t=N s" = seconds from the start of this video
(the stamp is not part of the original recording). Read start_s, end_s and every video_s from that stamp; do not estimate time.
PIECE: this file is piece 3 of 4 of a longer recording; it covers t=935 s to t=1427 s of the FULL recording.
The stamp shows seconds of the FULL recording, so read start_s, end_s and video_s from the stamp as usual.
Answer every claim from this piece only: if this piece neither shows nor contradicts a claim, use not_found
(another piece may show it). For camera_clock, "first frame" and "last frame" mean the first and last frame of this piece.
status: on_recording = the video or the speech clearly supports the claim at start_s..end_s;
not_found = the recording neither shows nor contradicts the claim (start_s=end_s=-1);
check = the recording contradicts the claim, or shows only part of it in a way that matters (for example the claim says
a man was clinging to a pipe and the recording shows him floating free). If unsure between on_recording and check, use check.
A name, rank or job title that the recording cannot show does not by itself make a claim partial: if the event is shown,
use on_recording and say in reason that the name or rank is not shown.
evidence: what is visible or said at that time. When you quote speech, copy the words exactly from TURNS inside double quotes.
reason: one sentence why this status.
camera_clock: read the date and time the body camera burned into the frame (for example "2026-09-27 21:00:29 -0400  AXON BODY 4 D01A16937",
usually top-right) on the first frame, on the last frame, and wherever the camera id or the clock jumps (the video can join several cameras).
For each reading give video_s (from our stamp), clock exactly as printed (date and time) and camera (the id printed, or "").
If the camera prints no clock, return an empty list.

CLAIMS (kind in brackets):
C1. [action] Deputies responded to a report of a possible drowning in the marina.
C2. [object] The area was behind a locked gate.
C3. [action] A man had fallen out of his wheelchair into the marina.
C4. [action] The man was clinging to a pipe to keep his head above water.
C5. [action] A sergeant jumped into the water with a buoy.
C6. [action] The man was floated to safety.
C7. [action] The man was evaluated by the fire department and declined further medical attention.
C8. [action] A passing boater pulled the man out of the water before deputies arrived.
C9. [speech] The man told deputies he had been drinking.
C10. [action] Units responded to a house fire with two people believed to be inside.
C11. [action] A deputy kicked down the front door.
C12. [action] The deputy pulled the female resident to safety.
C13. [action] The deputy rendered aid until Fire Rescue took over.
C14. [action] Firefighters pulled the male occupant from the house.
C15. [action] The deputy entered the house through a back window.
C16. [action] A neighbor handed the deputy a fire extinguisher.
C17. [object] The suspect vehicle had lost a front wheel.
C18. [object] The vehicle got stuck at a construction site.
C19. [action] Deputies detained the driver.
C20. [object] The driver appeared to be under the influence.
C21. [action] The driver resisted and kicked a deputy while being escorted into the back of a patrol vehicle.
C22. [speech] When asked about the crash, the driver responded "What crash?"
C23. [speech] The driver asked deputies to release him in exchange for $2,000.
C24. [action] The driver walked to the patrol car calmly and without resisting.
C25. [speech] The driver said he was late for a job interview.
C26. [object] When found, the dog's body was covered in sores and he was weak.
C27. [object] The dog has gained a significant amount of weight since he was admitted to the shelter.
C28. [action] The owner was arrested.
C29. [speech] The owner denied the neglect.
C30. [speech] The owner asked for his mom.
C31. [object] A pipe was found in the owner's pocket.
C32. [speech] The owner thanked the detectives for taking care of the dog.
C33. [action] The owner was arrested inside a moving car during a traffic stop.
C34. [action] A motorcycle fled from deputies during a traffic operation.
C35. [action] The motorcycle sped at high speed, weaving in and out of traffic.
C36. [object] The aviation unit was overhead when the rider stopped to refuel.
C37. [action] The rider stopped to refuel at a gas station.
C38. [action] The rider stopped voluntarily for deputies on the highway shoulder.
C39. [action] A passenger was riding on the back of the motorcycle.
C40. [action] The driver was stopped for driving 120 mph on I-95.
C41. [action] The driver was going more than 50 mph over the speed limit.
C42. [action] The driver was arrested.
C43. [action] The deputy let the driver go with a warning.
C44. [action] The driver's dog jumped out of the car and ran across the highway.
C45. [action] Deputies spotted a gold Chrysler minivan parked over the fuel port at a Racetrac gas station.
C46. [action] The van then parked at a nearby Waffle House, where the driver ran from responding deputies.
C47. [action] The driver was taken into custody after a short foot chase.
C48. [object] The minivan was carrying a large auxiliary fuel tank.
C49. [object] A hole was cut through the floorboard of the minivan.
C50. [object] The chassis was sitting on wooden 2x4 blocks strapped to the axle using metal retention straps.
C51. [object] Gas cans and a hose were found in the back of the second minivan.
C52. [action] The minivan driver gave up at the gas pump without running.
C53. [action] Deputies found a stolen motorcycle inside the minivan.
C54. [action] The Nissan sedan came to a stop after striking a parked vehicle.
C55. [action] The driver and a passenger took off running while a female passenger stayed behind.
C56. [action] The Air One crew spotted two suspects hiding in the water.
C57. [action] FWC responded with an airboat to bring both suspects back to dry land.
C58. [object] A firearm with an extended magazine was recovered from the Nissan.
C59. [object] A .22 Uzi pistol was found inside a backpack that was discarded at the scene.
C60. [action] Both suspects swam to shore on their own and walked up to the deputies.
C61. [action] The suspects threw a bag of cash into the water.
C62. [action] A rip current pulled the swimmer about 100 yards out in the ocean.
C63. [object] The swimmer was unresponsive with no pulse when lifeguards brought him in.
C64. [object] The swimmer regained a pulse.
C65. [object] The swimmer made a full recovery.
C66. [action] The swimmer walked out of the water on his own.
C67. [action] A dog on the beach barked and alerted the lifeguards.
C68. [action] A boat was spinning in circles on the lake.
C69. [action] Responding units spotted a single unresponsive occupant on the boat.
C70. [action] The Marine Unit crew moved in close enough for a rescuer to jump on board.
C71. [action] The rescuer stopped the boat.
C72. [action] The patient was taken to shore for further treatment.
C73. [action] Two people were on the boat, waving for help.
C74. [object] The boat had run aground on a sandbar before deputies arrived.
